newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel 1 bln peso debt permit renewed.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel 1 bln peso debt permit renewed.

text.p: Food and beer conglomerate San Miguel Corp got approval on Monday from the Securities and Exchange Commission to renew its licence to issue one billion pesos of short-term and three billion pesos worth of long-term commercial papers.
The company's permit to issue these papers expired on September 15, 1996.
The proceeds of the short-term papers will be used to finance the company's working capital requirements, while the long-term will fund the acquisition of fixed assets.

Private credit rating agency, Credit Information Bureau Inc, had rated San Miguel's short-term paper CIB 1 minus, near the best grade of CIB 1. Its long-term debt is rated CIB Aa, the second highest grade.
The lead selling agent for the short-term paper are AB Capital & Investment Corp and BPI Capital Corp. AB Capital is also the lead underwriter of the long-term paper.
